actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is moved into major-incident handling and the command and communication cadence is started.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm major-incident status is recorded.
  containIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: Confirm the configuration item or incident record shows the isolation request or execution status is recorded.
  failOverService:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: "Confirm the restoration record, target record, or incident record shows the approved backup restoration was initiated or completed."
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

### Turn 53 — user

- implemented by — Relates an IT service to the application that implements it.
- runs on — Relates an IT service to the infrastructure component on which it runs.
- owned by application owner — Relates an application to the application owner accountable for it.
- owns IT service — Relates a service owner to the IT service accountable to that role.
- accountable for business service — Relates a business owner to the business service for which that role is accountable.
- member of resolver group — Relates an on-call engineer to the resolver group they belong to.
- depends on third-party service — Relates an IT service to an external service it depends on.
- uses database — Relates an application to the database it uses.
- stored on — Relates a database to the storage system on which it is stored.
- affects configuration item — Relates an incident to a configuration item directly affected by the incident.

classes:
  Incident:
    meaning: "An incident is an unplanned interruption, degradation, or security condition that requires managed response."
    aliases: []
    properties:
      status:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - new
          - acknowledged
          - investigating
          - contained
          - recovering
          - monitoring
          - resolved
          - closed
          - cancelled
      severity:
        type: text
      detectedTime:
        type: date
      openedTime:
        type: date
      closureTime:
        type: date
  Alert:
    meaning: An alert is a monitoring or security signal that requires triage or acknowledgement.
    aliases: []
    properties:
      status:
        type: text
        allowed:

          - acknowledged
          - suppressed
          - escalated
          - closed
      severity:
        type: text
      acknowledgedTime:
        type: date
      raisedTime:
        type: date
  ITService:
    meaning: An IT service is a managed technology capability that supports one or more business services.
    aliases:

    properties:
      healthState:

        allowed:
          - healthy
          - degraded
          - partially unavailable
          - unavailable
          - recovering
          - unknown
  BusinessService:

    aliases:

    properties: {}
  ConfigurationItem:
    meaning: A configuration item is a managed component within configuration-management scope.
    aliases:

    properties: {}
  ThirdPartyService:

    aliases:

    aliases: []
    properties:

    aliases:

actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is moved into major-incident handling and the command and communication cadence is started.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm major-incident status is recorded.
  containIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: Confirm the configuration item or incident record shows the isolation request or execution status is recorded.
  failOverService:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: "Confirm the restoration record, target record, or incident record shows the approved backup restoration was initiated or completed."
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

### Turn 54 — user

- escalated to vendor — Relates an incident to the vendor to which it has been escalated for support or action.
- provided by vendor — Relates a third-party service to the vendor that provides it.
- handled with runbook — Relates an incident to the runbook used to diagnose, respond to, recover, or verify it.
- recovered with recovery plan — Relates an incident to the recovery plan used for restoration.
- uses backup set — Relates a recovery plan to the backup set it uses for recovery.
- recovers IT service — Relates a recovery plan to the IT service it restores.
- deployed in environment — Relates an IT service to the environment in which it is deployed.
- documented by known error — Relates a problem to the known error that documents its diagnosed cause or workaround.
- has workaround — Relates a known error to the workaround available for it.
- evaluated by — Relates an incident to the materiality assessment used to determine its significance and reporting implications.

classes:
  Incident:

    aliases: []
    properties:

  containIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: Confirm the configuration item or incident record shows the isolation request or execution status is recorded.
  failOverService:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: "Confirm the restoration record, target record, or incident record shows the approved backup restoration was initiated or completed."
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.

  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

### Turn 55 — user

- triggers regulatory notification — Relates a materiality assessment to the regulatory notification it causes to be prepared or sent.
- sent to regulator — Relates a regulatory notification to the regulator that receives it.
- supported by evidence item — Relates an incident to the evidence item that supports analysis, verification, or accountability for it.
- requires preservation of evidence item — Relates a cybersecurity incident to evidence that must be preserved because of its security nature.
- about incident — Relates a communication to the incident it concerns.
- addressed to stakeholder — Relates a communication to the stakeholder audience it is directed to.
- reviews incident — Relates a post-incident review to the incident it examines.
- produces corrective action — Relates a post-incident review to the corrective action it creates as follow-up.
- linked to problem — Relates an incident to the problem representing its underlying or suspected cause.
- justified by incident — Relates an emergency change to the incident that justifies its accelerated handling.
- changes configuration item — Relates an emergency change to the configuration item it modifies.
- classifies incident — Relates a major incident or cybersecurity incident record to the incident it classifies.
- resolved by change — Relates an incident to the change used to resolve it.
- implemented by release — Relates a change to the release that implements it.
- delivered by deployment — Relates a release to the deployment that technically delivers it.
- assigned to resolver group — Relates an incident to the resolver group responsible for diagnosis and restoration.
- handled by on-call engineer — Relates an incident to the on-call engineer handling time-critical response.
- reports incident — Relates a regulatory notification to the incident it reports.

classes:
  Incident:
    meaning: "An incident is an unplanned interruption, degradation, or security condition that requires managed response."
    aliases: []
    properties:
      status:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - new
          - acknowledged
          - investigating
          - contained
          - recovering
          - monitoring

      closureTime:

    properties:

      severity:

  ITService:

        allowed:

          - partially unavailable
          - unavailable

    aliases:

    properties: {}
  ThirdPartyService:

    aliases:

    aliases: []
    properties:
      observedTime:
        type: date

### Turn 57 — user

In plain operational terms, we would only declare a major incident if all of the relevant gate conditions are in place:

- the incident is still active, so it is not already resolved, closed, or cancelled
- the severity is high enough to justify major-incident handling
- at least one impacted IT service has been identified
- an incident commander has been assigned

That is the practical decision set. The exact severity levels that qualify are fixed in the model rather than left open-ended.

actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is moved into major-incident handling and the command and communication cadence is started.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm major-incident status is recorded.
  containIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: Confirm the configuration item or incident record shows the isolation request or execution status is recorded.
  failOverService:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: "Confirm the restoration record, target record, or incident record shows the approved backup restoration was initiated or completed."
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

  - id: cq1

classes:
  Incident:
    meaning: "An incident is an unplanned interruption, degradation, or security condition that requires managed response."
    aliases: []
    properties:
      status:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - new
          - acknowledged
          - investigating
          - contained
          - recovering
          - monitoring
          - resolved
          - closed
          - cancelled
      severity:
        type: text
      detectedTime:
        type: date
      openedTime:
        type: date
      closureTime:
        type: date
  Alert:
    meaning: An alert is a monitoring or security signal that requires triage or acknowledgement.
    aliases: []
    properties:
      status:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - new
          - acknowledged
          - suppressed
          - escalated
          - closed
      severity:
        type: text
      acknowledgedTime:
        type: date
      raisedTime:
        type: date
  ITService:
    meaning: An IT service is a managed technology capability that supports one or more business services.

      - IT service

        allowed:
          - healthy
          - degraded
          - partially unavailable
          - unavailable
          - recovering
          - unknown
  BusinessService:

    aliases:
      - business service

  CustomerChannel:
    meaning: A customer channel is a channel through which customers access banking services.
    aliases:
      - customer channel
    properties: {}
  ConfigurationItem:
    meaning: A configuration item is a managed component within configuration-management scope.
    aliases:
      - configuration item
    properties: {}
  ThirdPartyService:
    meaning: A third-party service is an externally provided service on which the bank depends.
    aliases:
      - third-party service

  Event:
    meaning: An event is a time-stamped observation of a state change or other noteworthy occurrence.
    aliases: []
    properties:
      observedTime:

  ResolverGroup:
    meaning: A resolver group is a team assigned to diagnose and restore a specific technology or service area.

  OnCallEngineer:
    meaning: An on-call engineer is a technical specialist available for time-critical operational response.

  BusinessOwner:

      - business owner

  ServiceOwner:

  BackupSet:

classes:
  Incident:
    meaning: "An incident is an unplanned interruption, degradation, or security condition that requires managed response."
    aliases: []
    properties:
      status:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - new
          - acknowledged
          - investigating
          - contained
          - recovering
          - monitoring
          - resolved
          - closed
          - cancelled
      severity:
        type: text
      detectedTime:
        type: date
      openedTime:
        type: date
      closureTime:
        type: date
  Alert:
    meaning: An alert is a monitoring or security signal that requires triage or acknowledgement.
    aliases: []
    properties:
      status:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - new
          - acknowledged
          - suppressed
          - escalated
          - closed
      severity:
        type: text
      acknowledgedTime:
        type: date
      raisedTime:
        type: date
  ITService:
    meaning: An IT service is a managed technology capability that supports one or more business services.
    aliases:
      - IT service
    properties:
      healthState:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - healthy
          - degraded
          - partially unavailable
          - unavailable
          - recovering
          - unknown
  BusinessService:
    meaning: A business service is a customer-facing or business-facing capability delivered by the bank.
    aliases:
      - business service
    properties: {}
  CustomerChannel:
    meaning: A customer channel is a channel through which customers access banking services.
    aliases:
      - customer channel
    properties: {}
  ConfigurationItem:
    meaning: A configuration item is a managed component within configuration-management scope.
    aliases:
      - configuration item
    properties: {}
  ThirdPartyService:
    meaning: A third-party service is an externally provided service on which the bank depends.
    aliases:
      - third-party service
    properties: {}
  Event:
    meaning: An event is a time-stamped observation of a state change or other noteworthy occurrence.
    aliases: []
    properties:
      observedTime:
        type: date
  ResolverGroup:
    meaning: A resolver group is a team assigned to diagnose and restore a specific technology or service area.
    aliases:
      - support group
    properties: {}
  OnCallEngineer:
    meaning: An on-call engineer is a technical specialist available for time-critical operational response.
    aliases:
      - on-call
    properties: {}
  BusinessOwner:
    meaning: A business owner is the business role accountable for a business service or process.
    aliases:
      - business owner
    properties: {}
  ServiceOwner:
    meaning: A service owner is the role accountable for an IT service across its lifecycle.
    aliases:
      - service owner
    properties: {}
  Runbook:
    meaning: "A runbook is a maintained operational procedure for diagnosis, response, recovery, or verification."
    aliases:
      - playbook
    properties: {}
  Workaround:
    meaning: A workaround is a temporary method that reduces or bypasses the impact of an incident or problem.
    aliases: []
    properties: {}
  KnownError:
    meaning: A known error is a diagnosed problem with a documented cause or workaround.
    aliases:
      - known error
    properties: {}
  BackupSet:
    meaning: A backup set is a defined collection of recoverable backup data for protected components.
    aliases:
      - backup set
    properties:

        type: date
      backupStatus:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - scheduled
          - running
          - successful
          - failed
          - expired
          - corrupted
          - verified
  RecoveryPlan:
    meaning: A recovery plan is a documented plan for restoring an IT service and its dependencies.
    aliases:
      - DR plan
    properties:
      recoveryObjectiveTime:
        type: text
      recoveryObjectivePoint:
        type: text
      lastReviewTime:
        type: date
  MaterialityAssessment:
    meaning: A materiality assessment is a documented determination of incident significance and reporting implications.
    aliases:

  RegulatoryNotification:
    meaning: A regulatory notification is a formal incident-related submission to a competent authority.

  Stakeholder:

  Change:

        allowed:

  MajorIncident:

actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is moved into major-incident handling and the command and communication cadence is started.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm major-incident status is recorded.
  containIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: Confirm the configuration item or incident record shows the isolation request or execution status is recorded.
  failOverService:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: "Confirm the restoration record, target record, or incident record shows the approved backup restoration was initiated or completed."
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

classes:
  Incident:
    meaning: "An incident is an unplanned interruption, degradation, or security condition that requires managed response."
    aliases: []
    properties:
      status:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - new
          - acknowledged
          - investigating
          - contained
          - recovering
          - monitoring
          - resolved
          - closed
          - cancelled
      severity:

  Alert:

  ITService:

rules:
  qualifiesForMajorIncident:
    conditions:
      - incident status is not resolved
      - incident status is not closed
      - incident status is not cancelled
      - incident severity is sev1-critical or sev2-high
      - at least one impacted IT service is identified
      - the major incident is commanded by an incident commander
actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is moved into major-incident handling and the command and communication cadence is started.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm major-incident status is recorded.
  containIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: Confirm the configuration item or incident record shows the isolation request or execution status is recorded.
  failOverService:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: "Confirm the restoration record, target record, or incident record shows the approved backup restoration was initiated or completed."
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

classes:

rules:
  qualifiesForMajorIncident:
    conditions:
      - incident status is not resolved
      - incident status is not closed
      - incident status is not cancelled
      - incident severity is sev1-critical or sev2-high
      - at least one impacted IT service is identified
      - the major incident is commanded by an incident commander
  canSubmitRegulatoryNotification:
    conditions:
      - materiality assessment outcome is reportable
      - the regulatory notification reports the incident
      - the regulatory notification is sent to a regulator
      - the regulatory notification status is approved
      - required fields are complete
      - supporting evidence is complete
      - submission happens before the regulatory notification due time
actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is moved into major-incident handling and the command and communication cadence is started.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm major-incident status is recorded.
  containIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: Confirm the configuration item or incident record shows the isolation request or execution status is recorded.
  failOverService:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: "Confirm the restoration record, target record, or incident record shows the approved backup restoration was initiated or completed."
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

classes:
  Incident:
    meaning: "An incident is an unplanned interruption, degradation, or security condition that requires managed response."

    properties:

        allowed:

          - acknowledged

rules:
  qualifiesForMajorIncident:
    conditions:
      - incident status is not resolved
      - incident status is not closed
      - incident status is not cancelled
      - incident severity is sev1-critical or sev2-high
      - at least one impacted IT service is identified
      - the major incident is commanded by an incident commander
  canSubmitRegulatoryNotification:
    conditions:
      - materiality assessment outcome is reportable
      - the regulatory notification reports the incident
      - the regulatory notification is sent to a regulator
      - the regulatory notification status is approved
      - required fields are complete
      - supporting evidence is complete
      - submission happens before the regulatory notification due time
actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: Alert
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is moved into major-incident handling and the command and communication cadence is started.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm major-incident status is recorded.
  containIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: Confirm the configuration item or incident record shows the isolation request or execution status is recorded.
  failOverService:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: "Confirm the restoration record, target record, or incident record shows the approved backup restoration was initiated or completed."
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

classes:
  Incident:
    meaning: "An incident is an unplanned interruption, degradation, or security condition that requires managed response."
    aliases: []
    properties:
      status:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - new
          - acknowledged
          - investigating
          - contained
          - recovering
          - monitoring
          - resolved
          - closed
          - cancelled
      severity:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - sev1-critical
          - sev2-high
          - sev3-medium
          - sev4-low
      detectedTime:
        type: date
      openedTime:
        type: date
      closureTime:
        type: date
  Alert:
    meaning: An alert is a monitoring or security signal that requires triage or acknowledgement.
    aliases: []
    properties:
      status:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - new
          - acknowledged
          - suppressed
          - escalated
          - closed
      severity:
        type: text
      acknowledgedTime:
        type: date
      raisedTime:
        type: date
  ITService:
    meaning: An IT service is a managed technology capability that supports one or more business services.

      - IT service

      healthState:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - healthy
          - degraded
          - partially unavailable
          - unavailable
          - recovering
          - unknown
  BusinessService:
    meaning: A business service is a customer-facing or business-facing capability delivered by the bank.

    properties: {}
  CustomerChannel:
    meaning: A customer channel is a channel through which customers access banking services.
    aliases:
      - customer channel
    properties: {}
  ConfigurationItem:
    meaning: A configuration item is a managed component within configuration-management scope.
    aliases:
      - configuration item
    properties: {}
  ThirdPartyService:
    meaning: A third-party service is an externally provided service on which the bank depends.
    aliases:
      - third-party service
    properties: {}
  Event:
    meaning: An event is a time-stamped observation of a state change or other noteworthy occurrence.
    aliases: []
    properties:
      observedTime:
        type: date
  ResolverGroup:
    meaning: A resolver group is a team assigned to diagnose and restore a specific technology or service area.

      - support group
    properties: {}
  OnCallEngineer:
    meaning: An on-call engineer is a technical specialist available for time-critical operational response.
    aliases:
      - on-call
    properties: {}
  BusinessOwner:
    meaning: A business owner is the business role accountable for a business service or process.
    aliases:
      - business owner
    properties: {}
  ServiceOwner:
    meaning: A service owner is the role accountable for an IT service across its lifecycle.
    aliases:
      - service owner
    properties: {}
  Runbook:
    meaning: "A runbook is a maintained operational procedure for diagnosis, response, recovery, or verification."
    aliases:

    meaning: A workaround is a temporary method that reduces or bypasses the impact of an incident or problem.

  RecoveryPlan:

rules:
  qualifiesForMajorIncident:
    conditions:
      - incident status is not resolved
      - incident status is not closed
      - incident status is not cancelled
      - incident severity is sev1-critical or sev2-high
      - at least one impacted IT service is identified
      - the major incident is commanded by an incident commander
  canSubmitRegulatoryNotification:
    conditions:
      - materiality assessment outcome is reportable
      - the regulatory notification reports the incident
      - the regulatory notification is sent to a regulator
      - the regulatory notification status is approved
      - required fields are complete
      - supporting evidence is complete
      - submission happens before the regulatory notification due time
actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: Alert
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is moved into major-incident handling and the command and communication cadence is started.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm major-incident status is recorded.
  containIncident:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: Confirm the configuration item or incident record shows the isolation request or execution status is recorded.
  failOverService:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: "Confirm the restoration record, target record, or incident record shows the approved backup restoration was initiated or completed."
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: null
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

classes:
  Incident:
    meaning: "An incident is an unplanned interruption, degradation, or security condition that requires managed response."

    properties:
      status:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - new
          - acknowledged
          - investigating
          - contained
          - recovering
          - monitoring
          - resolved

rules:
  qualifiesForMajorIncident:
    conditions:
      - incident status is not resolved
      - incident status is not closed
      - incident status is not cancelled
      - incident severity is sev1-critical or sev2-high
      - at least one impacted IT service is identified
      - the major incident is commanded by an incident commander
  canSubmitRegulatoryNotification:
    conditions:
      - materiality assessment outcome is reportable
      - the regulatory notification reports the incident
      - the regulatory notification is sent to a regulator
      - the regulatory notification status is approved
      - required fields are complete
      - supporting evidence is complete
      - submission happens before the regulatory notification due time
actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: Alert
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is moved into major-incident handling and the command and communication cadence is started.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm major-incident status is recorded.
  containIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: Confirm the configuration item or incident record shows the isolation request or execution status is recorded.
  failOverService:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: BackupSet
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: "Confirm the restoration record, target record, or incident record shows the approved backup restoration was initiated or completed."
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: EmergencyChange
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: RegulatoryNotification
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

classes:
  Incident:
    meaning: "An incident is an unplanned interruption, degradation, or security condition that requires managed response."
    aliases: []
    properties:
      status:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - new
          - acknowledged
          - investigating
          - contained
          - recovering
          - monitoring
          - resolved
          - closed
          - cancelled
      severity:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - sev1-critical
          - sev2-high
          - sev3-medium
          - sev4-low
      detectedTime:
        type: date
      openedTime:
        type: date
      closureTime:

  Alert:
    meaning: An alert is a monitoring or security signal that requires triage or acknowledgement.
    aliases: []
    properties:

  ITService:

  Event:

    aliases: []

  ResolverGroup:

rules:
  qualifiesForMajorIncident:
    conditions:
      - incident status is not resolved
      - incident status is not closed
      - incident status is not cancelled
      - incident severity is sev1-critical or sev2-high
      - at least one impacted IT service is identified
      - the major incident is commanded by an incident commander
  canSubmitRegulatoryNotification:
    conditions:
      - materiality assessment outcome is reportable
      - the regulatory notification reports the incident
      - the regulatory notification is sent to a regulator
      - the regulatory notification status is approved
      - required fields are complete
      - supporting evidence is complete
      - submission happens before the regulatory notification due time
actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: Alert
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions:
      - qualifiesForMajorIncident
    effect: "The incident is classified as a major incident, an incident commander is assigned, and major-incident communication cadence is started."
    verification: Confirm a major incident record exists for the incident and that it is commanded by an incident commander.
  containIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: Confirm the configuration item or incident record shows the isolation request or execution status is recorded.
  failOverService:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: BackupSet
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: "Confirm the restoration record, target record, or incident record shows the approved backup restoration was initiated or completed."
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: EmergencyChange
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: RegulatoryNotification
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

rules:
  qualifiesForMajorIncident:
    conditions:
      - incident status is not resolved
      - incident status is not closed
      - incident status is not cancelled
      - incident severity is sev1-critical or sev2-high
      - at least one impacted IT service is identified
      - the major incident is commanded by an incident commander
  canSubmitRegulatoryNotification:
    conditions:
      - materiality assessment outcome is reportable
      - the regulatory notification reports the incident
      - the regulatory notification is sent to a regulator
      - the regulatory notification status is approved
      - required fields are complete
      - supporting evidence is complete
      - submission happens before the regulatory notification due time
actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: Alert
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions:
      - qualifiesForMajorIncident
    effect: "The incident is classified as a major incident, an incident commander is assigned, and major-incident communication cadence is started."
    verification: Confirm a major incident record exists for the incident and that it is commanded by an incident commander.
  containIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: "Confirm isolation through external or tool verification, and check affected IT service health state."
  failOverService:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: BackupSet
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: "Confirm the restoration record, target record, or incident record shows the approved backup restoration was initiated or completed."
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: EmergencyChange
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: RegulatoryNotification
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

rules:
  qualifiesForMajorIncident:
    conditions:
      - incident status is not resolved
      - incident status is not closed
      - incident status is not cancelled
      - incident severity is sev1-critical or sev2-high
      - at least one impacted IT service is identified
      - the major incident is commanded by an incident commander
  canSubmitRegulatoryNotification:
    conditions:
      - materiality assessment outcome is reportable
      - the regulatory notification reports the incident
      - the regulatory notification is sent to a regulator
      - the regulatory notification status is approved
      - required fields are complete
      - supporting evidence is complete
      - submission happens before the regulatory notification due time
actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: Alert
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions:
      - qualifiesForMajorIncident
    effect: "The incident is classified as a major incident, an incident commander is assigned, and major-incident communication cadence is started."
    verification: Confirm a major incident record exists for the incident and that it is commanded by an incident commander.
  containIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: "Confirm isolation through external or tool verification, and check affected IT service health state."
  failOverService:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: BackupSet
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: Validate data integrity and application functionality after the restore through external or tool verification.
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: EmergencyChange
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: RegulatoryNotification
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

rules:
  qualifiesForMajorIncident:
    conditions:
      - incident status is not resolved
      - incident status is not closed
      - incident status is not cancelled
      - incident severity is sev1-critical or sev2-high
      - at least one impacted IT service is identified
      - the major incident is commanded by an incident commander
  canSubmitRegulatoryNotification:
    conditions:
      - materiality assessment outcome is reportable
      - the regulatory notification reports the incident
      - the regulatory notification is sent to a regulator
      - the regulatory notification status is approved
      - required fields are complete
      - supporting evidence is complete
      - submission happens before the regulatory notification due time
actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: Alert
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions:
      - qualifiesForMajorIncident
    effect: "The incident is classified as a major incident, an incident commander is assigned, and major-incident communication cadence is started."
    verification: Confirm a major incident record exists for the incident and that it is commanded by an incident commander.
  containIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: "Confirm isolation through external or tool verification, and check affected IT service health state."
  failOverService:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: BackupSet
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: Validate data integrity and application functionality after the restore through external or tool verification.
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: EmergencyChange
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: RegulatoryNotification
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

  Incident:

        type: text
        allowed:

          - acknowledged
          - investigating
          - contained

      severity:

          - sev4-low
      detectedTime:
        type: date
      openedTime:

      closureTime:

rules:
  qualifiesForMajorIncident:
    conditions:
      - incident status is not resolved
      - incident status is not closed
      - incident status is not cancelled
      - incident severity is sev1-critical or sev2-high
      - at least one impacted IT service is identified
      - the major incident is commanded by an incident commander
  canSubmitRegulatoryNotification:
    conditions:
      - materiality assessment outcome is reportable
      - the regulatory notification reports the incident
      - the regulatory notification is sent to a regulator
      - the regulatory notification status is approved
      - required fields are complete
      - supporting evidence is complete
      - submission happens before the regulatory notification due time
actions:
  acknowledgeAlert:
    input: Alert
    preconditions: []
    effect: The alert is marked as acknowledged and no longer sits untriaged.
    verification: Read the alert record and confirm it is assigned an acknowledged state.
  assignIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident is routed to the selected resolver group for diagnosis and restoration.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the resolver group assignment is recorded.
  declareMajorIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions:
      - qualifiesForMajorIncident
    effect: "The incident is classified as a major incident, an incident commander is assigned, and major-incident communication cadence is started."
    verification: Confirm a major incident record exists for the incident and that it is commanded by an incident commander.
  containIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved containment workflow is triggered through people or external tools to limit spread or reduce impact.
    verification: Confirm the incident record shows the containment step was initiated and its scope recorded.
  isolateAffectedConfigurationItem:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An isolation workflow is triggered through people or external tools to remove the configuration item from network access or dependencies.
    verification: "Confirm isolation through external or tool verification, and check affected IT service health state."
  failOverService:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: A failover workflow is triggered through people or external tools to move service operation to the recovery environment under the applicable recovery plan.
    verification: Confirm the service record or incident record shows failover was initiated or completed under the selected recovery plan.
  restoreFromBackup:
    input: BackupSet
    preconditions: []
    effect: A restoration workflow is triggered through people or external tools to restore approved backup data to the intended target.
    verification: Validate restored data through external or tool verification.
  executeEmergencyChange:
    input: EmergencyChange
    preconditions: []
    effect: An emergency change workflow is triggered through people or external tools to implement an urgent controlled fix under the accelerated change path.
    verification: Confirm the linked change record shows the emergency change was created or moved into execution.
  sendStakeholderCommunication:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident update is issued to the relevant audience based on the latest verified state.
    verification: Confirm a communication record exists for the incident and reflects the approved update.
  submitRegulatoryNotification:
    input: RegulatoryNotification
    preconditions: []
    effect: An approved incident-related regulatory submission is triggered through people or external tools to the relevant authority.
    verification: Confirm the regulatory notification record shows submission was initiated or completed.
  closeIncident:
    input: Incident
    preconditions: []
    effect: The incident record is formally closed once closure conditions are satisfied.
    verification: Read the incident record and confirm the closure state is recorded.

          - new
          - acknowledged
          - investigating
          - contained
          - recovering
          - monitoring
          - resolved

          - cancelled

        type: text

          - sev3-medium
          - sev4-low

        type: date
      openedTime:
        type: date
      closureTime:
        type: date

    aliases: []
    properties:
      status:
        type: text
        allowed:
          - new
          - acknowledged
          - suppressed
          - escalated
          - closed
      severity:

        type: date
      raisedTime:
        type: date
  ITService:

        type: text
        allowed:
          - healthy

          - unavailable
          - recovering

    aliases:

    properties: {}
  CustomerChannel:
    meaning: A customer channel is a channel through which customers access banking services.
